locale.description: BCP 47 tag. Must match the file name and the .lproj / locale directory it generates.

keys.description: Key to entry. Keys are stable identifiers, never English sentences.

value.description: The string. Placeholders are named ({provider}); plurals are ICU ({count, plural, one {#} other {#}}).

comment.description: For translators: what the string labels and where it appears. Required in the source locale.

placeholders.description: Declared in the source locale only. Every locale's value must use exactly this set.
